moments.action: Amah faces her elderly brother in the lounge; the angle widens to show him standing by her rented hospital bed, head bowed over his cane, and M on the carved sofa turning to look at them.
Held close-up of Amah in her knit cap listening without answering; her eyes drop by the end of the take. Cut to M on the sofa, staring back across the room.

Long wide take: the brother stands bowed on his cane beside the bed, Amah's back filling the foreground. By the end she has left the frame and M stands behind him, relatives visible through the window.
On a crowded train Amah sits still in her cap, M reflected in the window behind her; a close-up catches him looking down, and by the last shot passengers press in and gesture around her.
Static golden-hour wide of the overgrown railway track beside the trackside path; distant figures walk slowly toward camera, drifting closer across the held take.
